title: Fundamentals Of Broadcasting
modules: Emergence Of The Nigerian Broadcast Media… 24-30
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used, the principle of patching is the same."
Whatever method is used, the principle of patching is the same.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most modern, while valvalised variety are old fashioned and could be water-cooled or air-cooled."
The transistorized transmitter is the most modern, while valvalised variety are old fashioned and could be water-cooled or air-cooled.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the dissemination of information from a radio or television station through the air waves."
Broadcasting is the dissemination of information from a radio or television station through the air waves.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the number of waves passing a certain point in a given interval of time."
Frequency is the number of waves passing a certain point in a given interval of time.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the signal source; it is the place where signals originate."
The studio is the signal source; it is the place where signals originate.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a type of resistance to the signal flow."
Impedance is a type of resistance to the signal flow.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is made up of the camera head, the camera control unit, the sync generator and the power supply."
The camera chain is made up of the camera head, the camera control unit, the sync generator and the power supply.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a potent weapon for interactive communication and has many of the characteristics of face-to-face communication."
The new media is a potent weapon for interactive communication and has many of the characteristics of face-to-face communication.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an essential organizing element in television production."
Time is an essential organizing element in television production.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the nerve center of a television station."
Master-control is the nerve center of a television station.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used whenever the sound source is fixed and the type of programming permits them to be seen."
Stand microphones are used whenever the sound source is fixed and the type of programming permits them to be seen.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the phenomenon in which the radio waves travel into the sky instead of along the earth's contour."
Sky waves propagation is the phenomenon in which the radio waves travel into the sky instead of along the earth's contour.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a mini and unidirectional transmitter, which usually is used to boost signals from origin to the main transmitter in remote areas."
The Microwave is a mini and unidirectional transmitter, which usually is used to boost signals from origin to the main transmitter in remote areas.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an open area, which contains the microphones, sets performers and crew."
The studio floor is an open area, which contains the microphones, sets performers and crew.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the development of a situation, story, characters, copy and dialogue, with the special talents and skills of a writer."
Scripting is the development of a situation, story, characters, copy and dialogue, with the special talents and skills of a writer.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to frame production shots to reveal visual images as clearly as possible and to present them so that they can convey meaning and energy."
Essentially cameras are used to frame production shots to reveal visual images as clearly as possible and to present them so that they can convey meaning and energy.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the clearing house for all programme material."
Master control is the clearing house for all programme material.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is made up of the studio and the control center and both of them constitute the workshop of broadcasting."
The studio suite is made up of the studio and the control center and both of them constitute the workshop of broadcasting.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the life wire of the control room because it performs a number of operations on the programme signals that emanate from the studio before the signals are transported to the transmitter."

The audio console is the life wire of the control room because it performs a number of operations on the programme signals that emanate from the studio before the signals are transported to the transmitter.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used in production situations in which complete and unrestricted mobility of the sound source is required."
Wireless microphones are used in production situations in which complete and unrestricted mobility of the sound source is required.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of several means of getting a message, to a large number of people at the same time, because it transcends the boundaries of space and time, and also leaps across illiteracy barriers."

Radio broadcasting is one of several means of getting a message, to a large number of people at the same time, because it transcends the boundaries of space and time, and also leaps across illiteracy barriers.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a written document that shows what the producer wants to do."
A programme proposal is a written document that shows what the producer wants to do.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means the selection, ordering, and airing of all programme material."
Programme retrieval means the selection, ordering, and airing of all programme material.
fib: ______ is one of them and its principal function is to ensure that broadcasters act in accordance with stipulated principles as contained in their frequency allocation letter.
Federal Ministry of Communication

The Federal Ministry of Communication is one of them and its principal function is to ensure that broadcasters act in accordance with stipulated principles as contained in their frequency allocation letter.
______ is an electro-acoustic transducer that converts acoustic energy into electrical energy.
microphone
A microphone is an electro-acoustic transducer that converts acoustic energy into electrical energy.
______ is the fastest means of communication.
Telephone
Telephone is the fastest means of communication.
______ is the cluster of commercials, teasers about upcoming programmes, public service announcements, and station identifications that appear between programmes.
station break
A station break is the cluster of commercials, teasers about upcoming programmes, public service announcements, and station identifications that appear between programmes.
______ is an important production aid for the crew and talent.
studio monitor
A studio monitor is an important production aid for the crew and talent.
______ is called CAMCORDER when docked with a VTR or a built-in VTR.
camera
The camera is called CAMCORDER when docked with a VTR or a built-in VTR.
______ is a situation where a company with the intention of broadcasting between Lagos and Abuja but seeks for licence of operation between Lagos, Ibadan and Ife.
overshot
An overshot is a situation where a company with the intention of broadcasting between Lagos and Abuja but seeks for licence of operation between Lagos, Ibadan and Ife.
______ is the acronym of Nigerian Communications Commission, a body that acts as the national regulatory authority for the telecommunication industry in Nigeria.
NCC
NCC is the acronym of Nigerian Communications Commission, a body that acts as the national regulatory authority for the telecommunication industry in Nigeria.
______ are used for various studio productions such as news, interview and panel shows or for daily serial dramas.
Studio cameras
Studio cameras are used for various studio productions such as news, interview and panel shows or for daily serial dramas.
______ is the most important electronic equipment in a broadcast studio, without which transmission of programme signals is impossible.
transmitter
The transmitter is the most important electronic equipment in a broadcast studio, without which transmission of programme signals is impossible.
______ is an independent regulatory commission, quasi judicial in many of its functions, but primarily administrative and policy making in its day-to-day operations.
FCC
The FCC is an independent regulatory commission, quasi judicial in many of its functions, but primarily administrative and policy making in its day-to-day operations.
______ is an auxiliary of the telex service and it is developed to meet the needs of Nigerian small-scale businesses.
telex delivery service
The telex delivery service is an auxiliary of the telex service and it is developed to meet the needs of Nigerian small-scale businesses.
______ is used for timing inserts, such as a 40-second videotape insert within a news programme.
stopwatch
The stopwatch is used for timing inserts, such as a 40-second videotape insert within a news programme.
______ is the return of the total or partial audio mix from the mixing console to the musicians.
Feedback
Feedback is the return of the total or partial audio mix from the mixing console to the musicians.
______ refers to the selection and proper sequencing of video images as supplied by cameras or other video sources.
Image control
Image control refers to the selection and proper sequencing of video images as supplied by cameras or other video sources.
______ is a vehicle for projecting personality, through which it attracts and holds an audience.
Radio
Radio is a vehicle for projecting personality, through which it attracts and holds an audience.
______ is the process of encoding information into the language of radio energy.
Modulation
Modulation is the process of encoding information into the language of radio energy.
______ is an experience which is unique for both the viewer and the artistes or performers and this can be used to the television communication's advantage.
Television viewing
Television viewing is an experience which is unique for both the viewer and the artistes or performers and this can be used to the television communication's advantage.
______ is any action or inaction constituting non-compliance with any provision of the code on the part of any broadcast operation.
Breach
Breach is any action or inaction constituting non-compliance with any provision of the code on the part of any broadcast operation.
______ are the most efficacious sound pick-up, device for all types of news shows, interviews that take place in one location, panel shows, drama and musical shows.
Lavaliere microphones
Lavaliere microphones are the most efficacious sound pick-up, device for all types of news shows, interviews that take place in one location, panel shows, drama and musical shows.

modulating signal
The modulating signal is the message you want to send.

Whenever hidden microphones

row of buttons
